props.name: children
props.description: The chart's parts. Root never inspects them. The plot is one tab stop. Hover a spoke, or focus the chart and use the arrow keys, to read it. ArrowLeft and ArrowRight move between spokes, and ArrowUp and ArrowDown between series. The series other than the nearest dim. On a touch screen a drag that starts on the dial scrubs round it, a tap pins the tooltip, and a second tap on the same spoke releases it.

props.name: config
props.description: Keyed by series, as in `Chart.Root`. Each entry is a `ChartSeriesConfig` with `label`, `color` and optionally `format`, `icon`, `missing` and `qualityKey`. A radar compares at most 4 series. A fifth literal key fails the type, and a fifth runtime key throws in development and draws the first four in production. It takes no `stack`, `projectedFrom`, `interval` or scale.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows, one per spoke. The first row's spoke points to 12 o'clock and the rest follow clockwise, so a cyclic profile such as the days of a week puts its last spoke beside its first. Negative values draw inside a zero ring. With no reading the chart shows `Empty` and has no tab stop. A server component can render the chart when every prop is plain data.

props.name: max
props.description: The radius maximum. The niced maximum of the data is the default. A `max` at or above the data maximum ends the domain at `max`, and when the data exceeds `max` the niced data maximum wins, so no reading is clamped. The centre is 0, or the niced minimum when a value is negative, and then the grid draws a zero ring.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles, with every public chart custom property typed. `--chart-hover-dim` is the opacity of the marks outside the active slot or slice, 0.45 by default, and 1 turns the dim off. Dot rings, seams and label halos paint `--surface`, the opaque fill the chart rests on, and the muted text on them reads `--surface-muted-foreground`. Fuse's opaque containers, such as Card, Frame.Panel, Alert, Dialog and Popover, set both, and the page's `--background` is the fallback. On a fill of your own, set both beside it: with `background: var(--muted)`, set `--surface: var(--muted)` and `--surface-muted-foreground: var(--muted-foreground)`. A translucent tint keeps the surface beneath it, and an image or a gradient has no colour for the cut-outs to match.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Where the popup rests on a vertical chart. "point" centres it on the active slot, inside the chart's box and then the viewport, and rests it 8 px above the highest mark under its own width: a bar, a stack top, a line or area stroke between readings, or a dot. A step to a taller neighbour lifts it over every mark on the way, and a step that would lower it by 16 px or less keeps its height. "top" pins it to the plot top and tracks x only, as a chart with Panels always does. A horizontal chart places it over or under the active row either way. A step to another slot glides the popup there over `--chart-glide`, 924 ms on a spring that never overshoots. It moves at once when it opens, flips side, or follows a scroll, a resize or a data update, when its path would leave the viewport, and under reduced motion. The popup stays open while the pointer moves onto it, and Escape closes it. A touch lift pins it, and a second tap dismisses it.
